**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 11.1).**

- **What's already fine:** §§ 11.2 and 11.3 meet the preferred position on data return (30 days from request, complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, with metadata; no withholding for fee disputes) and on deletion (secure deletion only after Customer confirms successful return, officer certification, legal-retention carve-out protected).
- **The problem:** § 11.1 requires Vendor to *immediately* discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data with no export or migration support — that is walk-away language under this rule, and it flatly contradicts §§ 11.2/11.3. No transition-assistance period exists anywhere else in the agreement, so the clause fails even the 90-day fallback.
- **Fix (validated, ok:true):** § 11.1 rewritten to give up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates including export and migration support, and to subordinate deletion to §§ 11.2 and 11.3 — removing the internal inconsistency in one edit, with 90 days flagged as an acceptable fallback in the comment.
